Note that this function does not get the same

functions.name: diagonal
corner
functions.docs:
\returns the vertex of the bounding box at the corner defined by
the corner-id corner. It works only for a 1D, 2D or 3D bounding box.
For 1D bounding boxes corners are named by 2 enum constants:
BottomLeft and BottomRight.
For 2D bounding boxes, corners are named by 4 enum constants:
BottomLeft, BottomRight, TopLeft, TopRight.
For 3D bounding boxes, the following names are added:
BottomLeftCeil, BottomRightCeil, TopLeftCeil, TopRightCeil.

functions.name: sample
functions.docs:
\returns a random point inside the bounding box sampled with

functions.name: contains
functions.docs: \returns true if the point \a p is inside the box \c *this.

functions.name: contains
functions.docs: \returns true if the box \a b is entirely inside the box \c *this.

functions.name: intersects
functions.docs:
\returns true if the box \a b is intersecting the box \c *this.
\sa intersection, clamp

functions.name: extend
functions.docs:
Extends \c *this such that it contains the point \a p and returns a reference to \c *this.
\sa extend(const AlignedBox&)

functions.name: extend
functions.docs:
Extends \c *this such that it contains the box \a b and returns a reference to \c *this.
\sa merged, extend(const MatrixBase&)

functions.name: clamp
functions.docs:
Clamps \c *this by the box \a b and returns a reference to \c *this.
\note If the boxes don't intersect, the resulting box is empty.
\sa intersection(), intersects()

functions.name: intersection
functions.docs:
Returns an AlignedBox that is the intersection of \a b and \c *this
\note If the boxes don't intersect, the resulting box is empty.
\sa intersects(), clamp, contains()

functions.name: merged
functions.docs:
Returns an AlignedBox that is the union of \a b and \c *this.
\note Merging with an empty box may result in a box bigger than \c *this.
\sa extend(const AlignedBox&)

functions.name: translate
functions.docs: Translate \c *this by the vector \a t and returns a reference to \c *this.

functions.name: translated
functions.docs: \returns a copy of \c *this translated by the vector \a t.

functions.name: exteriorDistance
functions.docs:
\returns the distance between the point \a p and the box \c *this,
and zero if \a p is inside the box.
\sa squaredExteriorDistance(const MatrixBase&), exteriorDistance(const AlignedBox&)

functions.name: exteriorDistance
functions.docs:
\returns the distance between the boxes \a b and \c *this,
and zero if the boxes intersect.
\sa squaredExteriorDistance(const AlignedBox&), exteriorDistance(const MatrixBase&)

functions.name: transformed

\returns a copy of \c *this transformed by \a transform and recomputed to
still be an axis-aligned box.

then this function smartly returns a const reference to \c *this.
